name: North Macedonia
summary: Possessing drugs, even for personal use, is reported to be a crime (not verified against the current code). Medical cannabis legal since 2016: low-strength oils in pharmacies, stronger forms on prescription.

poisonControl.name: National Control and Information Center for Poisonings (University Clinic for Toxicology), Skopje (24h)

callingForHelp: No Good Samaritan law or other specific legal protection for people who call for help in an overdose was found.

incb.title: INCB Green List 2026 – psychotropic substances under international control

who.title: WHO – World directory of poisons centres (2023)

lsd.note: UN Schedule I. Possession, even for own use, is reported to be a crime under the Criminal Code (not verified against the current text).

mushrooms.note: Psilocybin is UN Schedule I; mushrooms presumably treated likewise. Possession reported to be a crime.

dmt.note: UN Schedule I. Possession, even for own use, is reported to be a crime under the Criminal Code (not verified against the current text).

mescaline.note: UN Schedule I; cacti status not confirmed. Possession reported to be a crime.

dox.note: DOM, DOB, DOC: UN Schedule I. Possession, even for own use, is reported to be a crime under the Criminal Code (not verified against the current text).

nbomes.note: UN Schedule I since 2015. Possession, even for own use, is reported to be a crime under the Criminal Code (not verified against the current text).

2c-x.note: 2C-B is UN Schedule II. Possession, even for own use, is reported to be a crime under the Criminal Code (not verified against the current text).

2c-t-x.note: 2C-T compounds are not UN-controlled; national scheduling not confirmed.

5-meo-xxt.note: 5-MeO tryptamines are not UN-controlled; national scheduling not confirmed.

cannabis.note: Recreational possession reported to be a crime; large amounts 3 months–5 yrs. Medical cannabis legal since 2016 (pharmacies/prescription).

ketamine.note: Anaesthetic used in hospitals and veterinary practice; not UN-controlled and national control status not confirmed.

mxe.note: UN Schedule II since 2016. Possession, even for own use, is reported to be a crime under the Criminal Code (not verified against the current text).

dxm.note: Not UN-controlled; national control and prescription status not confirmed.

nitrous.note: Not internationally controlled; no national restriction confirmed.

amphetamines.note: UN Schedule II. Possession, even for own use, is reported to be a crime under the Criminal Code (not verified against the current text).

mdma.note: UN Schedule I. Possession, even for own use, is reported to be a crime under the Criminal Code (not verified against the current text).

cocaine.note: 1961 Convention drug. Possession, even for own use, is reported to be a crime under the Criminal Code (not verified against the current text).

ghb/gbl.note: GHB is UN Schedule II; possession reported to be a crime. GBL/1,4-BD status not confirmed.

opioids.note: Heroin etc. are controlled; possession reported to be a crime. Rx opioids need a prescription.

tramadol.note: Prescription-only painkiller; not UN-controlled and national control status not confirmed.

maois.note: MAOI antidepressants are prescription-only; harmala/Syrian rue status not confirmed; ayahuasca contains DMT (controlled).
